title: Plug-in function missing at export
description: Metadata-integrity check — formulas in which FileMaker replaced a plug-in function by <Function Missing> at export time, because the plug-in was not loaded on the exporting client. The calls are absent from the object graph and the text no longer names the plug-in.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A plug-in not loaded on the exporting client turns every call of its functions into the placeholder <Function Missing> — in the formula text and in the DDR. The call never reaches the object graph; where-used and the plug-in inventory do not see it, and the text no longer says which plug-in was meant.
rule.remediation: Re-export the file on a client where the plug-in is installed and enabled, then import again. Nothing can be recovered inside FM-Lab — the function name is absent from the export.
